AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_DELIVERY.title: Delivery
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_DELIVERY.description: A card with Delivery gains Retain and Exhaust. At the end of your turn, its Delivery decreases by 1. When Delivery reaches 0, the card is immediately played for free against a random valid target.
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_ANGEL.title: Angel
AK_EXUSIAI_KEYWORD_ANGEL.description: This card's Energy cost cannot increase this combat.
